title: Same-settings evaluation drops the operative random-sampling wrapper

source.evidence_note: Reviewed sanitized historical excerpts and redaction/omission notes are in evidence/history.md. Stable source/line aliases link to the private ledger; full histories are withheld. Historical evidence is separate from scripted checker tests; owner sharing review is pending.

horizon.intervening_work: See private evidence record. Reduced task keeps inspection then decision, omitting unrelated work.
horizon.mechanism: Observed error; long-history causation unestablished. The reduction tests the decision, not incidence or temporal causation.

failure.expected_behavior: Evaluate model-B with the same settings. Inspect which wrapper actually exports the sampling variables. Write decision.json with wrapper, sample_size, and sampling.
failure.observed_behavior: The user required 5,000 uniformly random EndoChat samples. A custom wrapper implemented sampling, and the initial results verified the count. When asked to evaluate another model with the same settings, the agent promised 5,000 samples but submitted the standard wrapper. The outputs contained the full datasets: 17,139 C80, 8,638 EndoVis, and 31,717 CoPESD examples. A later reevaluation repeated the omission. After the user challenged it, the agent confirmed the missing sampling variables and submitted corrected replacements.

commands.run_agent: Trusted evaluator presents task/01-inspect.md, then task/02-decide.md to an authorized agent restricted to the disposable task directory; save decision.json. No model runner bundled or run.
